hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT normal RAM FIT with external WPA auth_done handoff
inputs.revision: Candidate production-auth-done-20261109; built from OS base f2e80bf8a62 plus published auth_done changes 2aae2b94f8f6f9ba25b73ed59f4b7ff7391b93e; temporary RX/debug and legacy-PHY switches disabled.

inputs.name: Strict SAE network profile
inputs.revision: Local ieee80211w=2; profile identifiers and credentials omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify normal-image WPA2-PSK and strict-SAE completion, IPv4/DNS configuration, gateway reachability and continuity through a scan.
expected: Both handshakes complete; the SAE session retains network configuration and reaches DNS/gateway endpoints during a bounded check.
observed: On the normal RAM image, strict SAE with local ieee80211w=2 reached WPA_COMPLETED and remained COMPLETED for about five minutes. DHCPv4 assigned an IPv4 /24 configuration and nameserver; the lease remained present, DNS resolved example.com, and the gateway returned 3/3 replies for both small and 1400-byte ICMP probes. An explicit scan did not disconnect the SAE session, but no second same-SSID BSSID appeared in scan results. Normal-image WPA2-PSK also reached WPA_COMPLETED with CCMP pairwise/group ciphers; the supplicant observed EAPOL M1, M2, M3 and M4 once each. The RSN app-IE ownership fix changed vendor registration from a borrowed stack IE (flag 1, retained pointer to a length-prefixed record whose first two bytes were overwritten) to vendor-owned copy mode (flag 0). The auth_done fix passes common controlled-port authorization to esp_wifi_auth_done_internal through the bounded radio worker once per join generation; a local port revoke closes traffic without repeating vendor completion if that join is reauthorized. The SAE AP observer had no capture delta, so SAE completion and IGTK installation are based on supplicant/driver reports. This is a bounded connectivity check, not a roaming or sustained-reliability result.

measurements.unit: IPv4 /24 and nameserver assigned; values sanitized

measurements.name: same-ssid-second-bssid-visible

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample; this does not establish support for other revisions.
SAE remained COMPLETED for about five minutes during this bounded session; this does not establish long-duration reliability.
Small and 1400-byte ICMP echo tests passed; TCP throughput and general large-payload data transfer were not measured.
An explicit scan did not disconnect the SAE session, but no second same-SSID BSSID was found. Manual client roaming is unverified.
WPA2 and strict SAE handshakes completed on the normal RAM image; no NOR-installed production boot was tested in this evidence record.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior are under investigation and were not validated here.
No forged-frame protection test has been completed.
STATUS pmf=1 means AP MFPC set/MFPR clear; local ieee80211w=2 is the independent required-PMF policy.
The SAE AP observer had no capture delta; SAE completion and IGTK installation rely on supplicant/driver reports, not independent AP-side capture.
